entities.title: Flight
entities.summary: The player's attitude and speed, and how every object in the bubble moves and turns.
entities.purpose: Holds the flight model of RULES B.5 to B.8: roll and pitch rates with damping and auto-centre, the speed keys, the half-tick substep that carries the universe past and rotates it around the player, each object's own motion, and re-orthonormalisation every 16 ticks.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
The player never moves: everything else is moved around the origin.
